newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close sharply lower.

text.p: Dec 11 - U.S. debt futures closed sharply lower, with March T-bonds faltering below 113-00 late. The contract is poised to continue its decline, possibly to 112-16/32. Pivotal support is at 112-10/32 to 112-08/32, analysts said. Market faces CPI, jobless claims and retail sales on Thursday morning. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
